Actual use requires third-party image processing and an external CLI whose implementation is not included in the reviewed file.

content.value_statement: Existing photos may have lighting that does not match the desired mood or product presentation. This skill guides RunComfy relighting with model selection and precise lighting prompts.
actual_capabilities: Select Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA for dedicated still-image lighting changes.
Describe light sources, direction, color temperature, intensity, and multi-light setups in prompts.
Request preservation of subject identity, pose, framing, and product colors.
Route broader edits to Nano Banana 2 Edit or FLUX Kontext Pro.
Describe reference-based lighting transfer using GPT Image 2 Edit.
Provide CLI invocation examples, output-directory options, and documented exit-code meanings.
limitations: Requires the external RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and available hosted model endpoints.
Images and prompts are processed by third-party services rather than an offline local model.
Supports still-image relighting, not video relighting or image generation from scratch.
Subject preservation and lighting accuracy are model-dependent; the skill includes instructions, not tested image outputs.

use_cases.title: Refresh product catalog lighting
use_cases.description: Plan warm window lighting for an existing product photo while requesting preservation of product orientation and color.

use_cases.title: Explore portrait lighting moods
use_cases.description: Request golden-hour lighting, soft fill, or a rim light while keeping the portrait subject and pose consistent.

use_cases.title: Match a lighting reference
use_cases.description: Route a source image and lighting reference to a reference-capable edit model with explicit preservation instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Warm portrait lighting
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my provided portrait URL to plan a golden-hour relight. Preserve identity and pose. Show the plan before submitting.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Product light setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight my provided product image with a warm 3200K key from camera-left and soft cool fill. Preserve product orientation, framing, and colors.
prompt_templates.scenario: A product image needs a specified two-light setup.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Match a reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my source and lighting-reference URLs with GPT Image 2 Edit. Match reference direction, temperature, and contrast. Preserve the source subject and framing.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creative brief includes a target lighting reference.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Plan consistent gallery lighting
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan consistent soft window lighting across my provided product URLs using Nano Banana 2 Edit. Verify endpoint input semantics and shell-safe arguments before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: A product gallery needs a consistent lighting treatment.

output_examples.input: Plan a warm window-light relight for my product photo.
output: Illustrative plan: Use Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA for the dedicated lighting change.
Lighting: Warm key from camera-left with a soft shadow on the counter.
Preservation: Keep product orientation, framing, and color identity.
Submission: Use the provided image URL after approval. Save the result in the selected output directory.

output_examples.input: Match the lighting in my reference photo without changing my portrait subject.
output: Illustrative plan: Select GPT Image 2 Edit for a source image plus lighting reference.
Transfer: Match the reference direction, color temperature, and contrast.
Preservation: Keep the source subject identity and pose. Review the generated result for unintended changes.

best_practices: Specify light source, direction, temperature, and intensity, then state which subject details must remain unchanged.
Use only approved image URLs and confirm permission for third-party processing before submitting sensitive assets.
Pass structured inputs with safe shell quoting and review generated results for identity, framing, and color drift.
anti_patterns: Expecting subject identity or product colors to remain exact without inspecting the generated result.
Treating the still-image endpoint as a video relighting or image-generation workflow.
Uploading confidential images without approval or pasting API tokens into prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It guides changes to lighting direction, color temperature, intensity, and mood in an existing still image.

faq.question: Which model is the default?
faq.answer: The documented default is Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA. Other edit endpoints are suggested for broader changes or reference-based lighting.

faq.question: Can it match a reference photo?
faq.answer: The skill describes using GPT Image 2 Edit with a source image and a lighting reference.

faq.question: Will it preserve the subject exactly?
faq.answer: Preservation is requested through prompts, not guaranteed. Inspect identity, pose, framing, and product colors after generation.

faq.question: Does processing happen locally?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow uses authenticated RunComfy model APIs and downloads generated results through the CLI.

faq.question: Can it relight video or create a new image?
faq.answer: Those tasks are outside this skill. It links to separate generation skills and video workflows.
